# X55 Contrast Tool

**Homepage:** [http://gsmdev.de/index.php?c=viewprojektinfo&id=27](https://web.archive.org/web/20050313185721/http://gsmdev.de/index.php?c=viewprojektinfo&id=27) (web archive)<br/>
**Author:** ACiD[mrp]<br/>
**Platforms:** x35/x45/x55 (EGOLD)

<img
  className="screenshot"
  src={require("./x55-contrast-tool/img/x55-contrast-tool.png").default}
  alt={"X55 Contrast Tool: screenshot 1"}
/>

X55 Contrast Tool connects to a Siemens phone via the COM port and lets you read, change, and save the display contrast value.
The program has been tested on phones from the x35, x45, x55, and x60 families and immediately shows the selected contrast on the phone screen.
